title: MULTI-CASE: A Transformer-based Ethics-aware Multimodal Investigative Intelligence Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of the system's architecture against ethical design guidelines for intelligence applications (specifically mapping to guideline C1 'Discriminatory Bias' and R3 'Automated Inequality'). The evaluation relies on domain expert feedback and analyzes how human-in-the-loop visual analytics, confidence scoring, and transparent source attribution can mitigate both inherent algorithmic biases and human prejudices.
